description: Lays out a marked region in two or more columns while the rest of the page stays full width. Mark an open block with [.multi-column], and set the count with columns=3 (2 by default, 4 at most). Column spacing comes from the page.column-gap theme key, the same one the whole-document setting uses.
sampleContent: A marked region is laid out in columns while the surrounding prose keeps the full measure of the page.
